In the case report "Multiphasic anaphylaxis in the emergency and intensive care setting", the authors note that the auto-injectors used to treat the first two anaphylactic episodes in the presented adult patient contain only
(A) 0.15 mg of epinephrine, the dose more commonly supplied in pediatric auto-injectors.
(B) 0.3 mg of epinephrine, even if intended for use in adults.
(C) 0.01 mg/kg of body weight, with a maximum total dose of 0.5 mg.
(D) 0.5 mL of 1:1000 epinephrine solution, the usual adult intramuscular dose.
(E) 0.5 mg of epinephrine, as recommended for most adults over 50 kg.
